bestBets.overview: The first two runs by LUNE LUMINEUSE have contained merit and she looks close to a win. It was a good finish by SUNDAY VENDETTA second up and the mile looks ideal at this stage. GASOLINE RAINBOW should find the lead here and can run another honest race. PHILHARMONIC showed ability during his debut campaign and didn't have much luck when resuming. GLINDINGDEEL gradually gave ground from on pace at Murtoa but he was up in trip at only his second outing; wide draw the concern here.

raceTips.comment: Philharmonic's run first-up at Casterton is excusable given how the track played. He ran well last preparation and can improve stepping up to the mile. Lune Lumineuse comes out of a strong race at Warrnambool and maps to settle near the lead, which could be advantageous. Gasoline Rainbow had every chance to run well at Warracknabeal last start and was a touch weak considering how soft she found the lead. Suspect she will again be positioned at the front of the field, and that could take her a long way in this race.
